title: 他梦到教皇去世：醒来后教皇真走了，他如何连夜赶回罗马？
speaker: Jason Horowitz

segments.en: The Pope sort of had a great tradition of ruining my vacations.
segments.zh: 教皇有个很妙的传统，就是毁掉我的假期。

segments.en: Like he would either say something very important or unfortunately his health would dip.
segments.zh: 他要么说些非常重要的话，要么不幸地健康出状况。

segments.en: Something would always happen when I was on vacation, so I was constantly coming back from America, from wherever I was.
segments.zh: 我度假时总会出事，所以我总是从美国、从任何地方赶回来。

segments.en: So in this time I was up in Medema, which is on the Tuscan coast. It was very beautiful.
segments.zh: 这次我在托斯卡纳海岸的梅德马，非常美。

segments.en: And I actually, this sounds very crazy, but it's true, I dreamt that the Pope had died, right? And I woke up in the middle of the night.
segments.zh: 说起来很疯狂，但这是真的，我梦到教皇去世了，然后我半夜醒来。

segments.en: And I said, oh my god, I just dreamt that the Pope had died. And my wife turned to me and she said, no, it's just that you're always thinking about the Pope, right?
segments.zh: 我说，天哪，我刚梦到教皇去世了。我妻子转头说，不，只是你总想着教皇，对吧？

segments.en: And then again, in my defense, the Pope had died, right? So we were on some wavelength, the two of us.
segments.zh: 再说，为我辩护一下，教皇确实去世了，对吧？所以我们俩心有灵犀。

segments.en: Anyway, so rushed back to Rome, and on my daughter's laptop, and I was in the front seat, she was in the back with the dog, my son, some other people were in that car.
segments.zh: 总之，我赶回罗马，用我女儿的笔记本电脑，我坐前座，她和狗坐后座，我儿子和其他人也在车里。

segments.en: It was a bit of a clown car, me extremely stressed out in the front.
segments.zh: 有点像小丑车，我在前面极度紧张。

segments.en: But then began a very, very, very hectic, important couple of weeks.
segments.zh: 但随后开始了非常非常忙碌、重要的几周。
